people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.
translations.bsb: Moved with compassion, Jesus touched their eyes, and at once they received their sight and followed Him.
translations.kjv: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
translations.asv: And Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and straightway they received their sight, and followed him.
